faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Jangaon District Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 31 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Jangaon District Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 5 vacancies: 2 Sweeper, 3 Scavenger.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Jangaon District Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form and send it to O/o District Education Office, in coordination with MJPTBCWREIS, District Coordinator, Jangaon District, by in person or through registered post, to reach by 31 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 44 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: As per Department Guidelines for Sweeper, As per Department Guidelines for Scavenger.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Must have passed VII Class examination. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Medical Test is Mandatory for every Candidate attaining the exam.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications received after due dates will be summarily rejected.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Written Exam. Medical Test. Merit list will be prepared based on the marks obtained in Written Exam. Candidate is allowed to Exam along with any Valid Identity Proof and Black/Blue Ball Point Pen and exam pad Only.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is to be made on outsourcing basis and thereafter the services will be as per the need and also subject to satisfactory performance.
